text:
Ava (CEO): Quick weekly update and three asks for teams. High level: private-beta GA is close but gated; cost improvements look solid; latency needs a short tactical push. Friday 11:30am PT town hall (30m) 1. Details below.

DeployBot: Event created: 'Weekly exec sync  GA gating & latency plan' Friday 11:30am PT (30m).

Diego (VP Product): Product will require three green gates before GA announcement: p95 <= 195ms across US region, end-to-end error rate <0.4% over 15m, and zero critical regressions on the canonical eval. No external marketing until legal signs off.

Mina (VP Eng): Eng plan: 1) kernel fusion rollout tonight on a small fleet, 2) enable KV-prefix caching for session-heavy routes in canary, 3) run microbatch tuning with new scheduler. Canary will be 8% traffic for 90m. Target: metric snapshot by EOD Thursday. Need SRE to confirm alert tweaks.

Ravi (Head SRE): SRE will own the canary run. Requests: temporarily relax host CPU alert to 92% during the canary window, add a short-lived alert for cache-hit <72%, and ensure synthetic canary traffic uses the eval prompts. I'll publish the canary playbook and link it here.

Clara (Head Sales): Sales pausing GA commitments. We need final wording for enterprise pilots (SLA + incident credit). Legal, please prioritize SLA draft. Also, can we get a customer-facing FAQ about retention?

LegalBot: SLA draft and short redlines list queued; expect delivery by Thursday EOD. I'll also draft a one-paragraph FAQ for customers re: default retention.

Ava (CEO): Policy changes effective now for self-serve: 1) default data retention set to 30 days (customers can extend via contract for enterprise/dedicated), 2) Private early access requires completed security questionnaire + signed NDA, 3) incident response: Sev1/Sev2 Response Lead must be notified within 30 minutes. PMs/Support, update KB and UI copy.

Mina (VP Eng): Noted on retention. We'll update data retention TTL jobs and run a dry run in staging. Assigning engineer to update config and telemetry retention window.

Diego (VP Product): I'll update the self-serve UX text and the docs to call out the 30-day default and the opt-in steps.

Ravi (Head SRE): SRE will update on-call rotations for the 30-minute response requirement and add it to the incident runbooks.

Ava (CEO): Metrics to watch this week: hosted p95 latency (goal <=195ms), cost per 1k tokens (goal -15% MoM), and canary pass rate + eval quality. Owners: drop a 1-line status in #eng-status by 9am PT Thursday.

Clara (Head Sales): Copy. Sales will draft consumer-facing FAQ by Thu 12:00pm PT for prospects.

Mina (VP Eng): Quick Q: single-region canary or multi-region? My recommendation: single region first (us-west-2), then expand if stable.

Ava (CEO): Single region first, then controlled multi-region if metrics look good.

Diego (VP Product): If anyone expects a blocker for Friday's town hall, ping me ASAP so we can surface it.

Ava (CEO): Thank you everyone. Small list, high leverage. Focus the week on canary gates and shaving p95. :rocket:

Ravi (Head SRE): Will post canary playbook link here when live.

Mina (VP Eng): :thumbsup:

Ava (CEO): Appreciated. Also shoutout to infra and runtime for last week's cost improvements 1. Keep it up.
